description: This file defines a ToastService class responsible for managing toast notifications within a Blazor web application. It allows displaying notifications with different levels (Info, Success, Warning, Error), manages a countdown timer for auto-hiding toasts, and provides events for showing and hiding notifications.

classes.name: ToastService
classes.description: Service class managing toast notifications, with event handling and timer-based auto-hide functionality.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Triggers the display of a toast notification with specified message and level, and starts the countdown timer.

methods.name: StartCountdown
methods.description: Initializes or restarts the countdown timer to auto-hide the toast after a delay.

methods.name: SetCountdown
methods.description: Configures the countdown timer with a 3000ms interval and attaches the Elapsed event handler.

methods.name: HideToast
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the countdown elapses to trigger hiding the toast notification.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up timer resources when the service is disposed.
